rows.headcount_quote: GSA employs approximately 12,000 federal workers across its 11 regions and headquarters, supporting the Public Buildings Service (PBS) and Federal Acquisition Service (FAS).
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Knowledge-work-heavy: PBS real-estate/acquisition specialists, FAS contracting officers, TTS engineers, and central staff offices; minimal field/shift workforce.
rows.notes: Includes PBS (~6.5k) and FAS (~4k) plus staff offices. Excludes contractor workforce supporting GSA acquisitions.

rows.headcount_quote: SBA has roughly 6,000 employees across its headquarters and 68 district offices, plus disaster-assistance surge staff at the Office of Disaster Recovery and Resilience.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Program officers, loan officers, district-office field staff, and disaster-recovery case workers; ~70% are knowledge workers, with the remainder in operational disaster-response roles.
rows.notes: Permanent FTE ~3.3k; total swells to ~6k when disaster-assistance surge employees are counted.

rows.headcount_quote: NASA's civil servant workforce is approximately 18,000 employees across its 10 field centers, JPL, and headquarters, supported by tens of thousands of contractors.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Scientists, engineers, and mission-support knowledge workers dominate the civil-servant workforce; heavy LLM/code-assist uptake among engineering staff.
rows.notes: Civil-servant FTE only. Major centers: ARC, GSFC, JSC, KSC, LaRC, GRC, MSFC, Stennis, Langley; JPL is FFRDC operated by Caltech (~6k JPL staff are contractors, not FTE).

rows.headcount_source_title: NSF About the National Science Foundation
rows.headcount_quote: NSF is a $9 billion independent agency with a staff of about 1,700, including approximately 1,400 career employees and 300 IPA visiting scientists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Grants administration plus rotating research-science program officers — essentially all knowledge work.
rows.notes: Includes ~300 Intergovernmental Personnel Act (IPA) rotators from universities.

rows.headcount_quote: The SEC employed approximately 4,600 full-time equivalent staff at the end of FY 2024, including attorneys, accountants, examiners, and economists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Attorneys, accountants, examiners, and economists — entirely a knowledge-work regulator.

rows.headcount_quote: The FDIC ended 2024 with approximately 6,300 employees, primarily bank examiners, attorneys, and resolution specialists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Bank examiners, attorneys, and resolution specialists — all knowledge-work regulator roles.

rows.headcount_source_title: Federal Reserve Board — structure and staff
rows.headcount_quote: The Federal Reserve Board has approximately 3,000 staff at its Washington headquarters, including economists, attorneys, supervisors, and IT specialists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Economists, attorneys, bank supervisors, and IT staff at the Board — knowledge work end to end.
rows.notes: Board staff only — does NOT include the 12 regional Federal Reserve Banks (~20k additional staff, not part of FRB-the-agency for federal-inventory purposes).

rows.headcount_quote: The FTC has approximately 1,200 employees, including attorneys, economists, investigators, and support staff in Washington and seven regional offices.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Attorneys, economists, and investigators dominate — small knowledge-work regulator.

rows.headcount_quote: The FCC has about 1,500 employees, including engineers, attorneys, economists, and analysts across the Wireless, Wireline, Media, International, and Public Safety Bureaus.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Engineers, attorneys, economists, and analysts across the bureaus — telecom regulator with knowledge-work staffing.

rows.headcount_quote: FERC employs about 1,500 staff, including engineers, economists, attorneys, and energy industry analysts.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Engineers, economists, attorneys, and energy analysts — knowledge-work regulator.

rows.headcount_quote: FHFA has approximately 800 employees who supervise Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and the Federal Home Loan Banks.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Examiners, financial analysts, and attorneys overseeing the GSEs — knowledge-work regulator.

rows.headcount_quote: FRTIB has approximately 270 staff who administer the Thrift Savings Plan on behalf of nearly 7 million federal participants.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: TSP administration: investment, IT, legal, and benefits-operations knowledge workers.
rows.notes: TSP recordkeeping outsourced to a contractor (Accenture FS); FRTIB's own FTE is small.

rows.headcount_quote: SSA has approximately 58,000 employees serving the public from 1,200+ field offices, teleservice centers, processing centers, and headquarters.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Majority of staff are field-office claims representatives, teleservice agents, and disability adjudicators — heavily scripted customer-service workflows; ~45% (headquarters, OIG, OGC, OCIO, policy, actuaries, ALJs) are plausible LLM users.
rows.notes: Field-office workforce dominates; SSA is unusual among regulators in having ~50% non-knowledge-work staff.

rows.headcount_quote: USAID had approximately 10,000 staff worldwide at the end of FY 2024, including U.S. direct hires, Foreign Service Nationals, and personal-services contractors across roughly 80 missions.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Mix of program officers, foreign-service officers, technical advisors, and mission support — mostly knowledge work, with a portion of mission-based operations/security excluded.
rows.notes: AGENCY DISSOLVED 2025 — workforce reported as of FY24. Remaining functions absorbed into State Department per 2025 reorganization.

rows.headcount_quote: TVA is a corporate agency of the United States that provides electricity for business customers and local power distributors serving 10 million people in seven southeastern states, employing approximately 10,000 staff.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: ~6k staff operate generation/transmission plant (nuclear, hydro, coal, gas) on shift schedules; ~3.5k knowledge workers (engineering, finance, IT, policy, environmental).
rows.notes: Government corporation, not OMB inventory filer; included for workforce context.

rows.headcount_quote: OPM employs approximately 5,600 staff across its Washington headquarters and the Federal Investigative Records Enterprise, supporting HR, retirement, health benefits, and workforce policy for 2.2 million federal employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: HR specialists, policy analysts, IT, benefits administration, and federal investigators — knowledge work throughout.
rows.notes: Background-investigation function transferred to DCSA (DOD) in 2019; remaining OPM workforce is HQ-heavy.

rows.headcount_quote: The NRC has approximately 3,000 employees, including engineers, scientists, inspectors, and security analysts at headquarters and four regional offices.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Engineers, scientists, attorneys, and technical reviewers regulating commercial nuclear — knowledge-work technical regulator.

rows.headcount_quote: NARA has approximately 3,000 staff at the National Archives Building, Archives II in College Park, the presidential libraries, and 14 federal records centers nationwide.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Archivists, records-management specialists, IT, and digitization staff — knowledge work, with a small custodial/facilities exclusion.

rows.headcount_quote: The CFTC has approximately 700 staff, including attorneys, economists, examiners, and IT specialists across headquarters and three regional offices.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Attorneys, economists, examiners — small derivatives-market regulator.

rows.headcount_quote: The CFPB has approximately 1,700 employees, including examiners, attorneys, economists, and consumer-complaint specialists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Examiners, attorneys, economists, and complaint analysts — small consumer-finance regulator.

rows.headcount_quote: The NLRB has approximately 1,200 employees in 26 regional offices and headquarters, primarily attorneys, field examiners, and administrative law judges.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Attorneys, field examiners, and ALJs — small labor regulator.

rows.headcount_quote: EEOC has approximately 2,000 employees nationwide — investigators, mediators, attorneys, and administrative judges — at 53 field offices and headquarters.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Investigators, mediators, attorneys, and AJs — small civil-rights regulator with knowledge-work staffing.

rows.headcount_source_title: MSPB About — Merit Systems Protection Board
rows.headcount_quote: MSPB has approximately 200 employees, including administrative judges and legal staff in Washington headquarters and six regional offices.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Administrative judges and attorneys — tiny adjudicatory body, all knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: PBGC has approximately 1,000 employees who insure private-sector defined-benefit pension plans for 31 million workers.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Actuaries, attorneys, benefits administrators, and IT — pension-insurance knowledge work.

rows.headcount_source_title: USITC About — U.S. International Trade Commission
rows.headcount_quote: The USITC has approximately 400 employees, including international-trade analysts, economists, attorneys, and investigators.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Trade economists, attorneys, and Section 337 investigators — small knowledge-work commission.

rows.headcount_quote: The U.S. AbilityOne Commission is a small independent federal agency with approximately 35 staff overseeing the procurement program that employs Americans who are blind or have significant disabilities.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Small program-oversight office: contracting, policy, IG — all knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: The Morris K. Udall and Stewart L. Udall Foundation has approximately 25 staff supporting its scholarship, native-nations institute, and environmental-conflict-resolution programs.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Scholarship administration and environmental dispute mediation — all knowledge work.

rows.headcount_source_title: NIGC Agency Overview — National Indian Gaming Commission
rows.headcount_quote: The NIGC has approximately 130 staff at headquarters and seven regional offices, including auditors, investigators, and compliance specialists overseeing tribal gaming.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Auditors, investigators, attorneys, and compliance specialists — small gaming regulator.
